scoring_justification: The headline quantities (penetration depths, reflection ratios) are derived from a Monte Carlo simulation; recomputing from raw simulation data would require a precise specification of the computational mesh and coordinate system that is not part of the output contract, so result-level comparison against the paper's reported values with tolerances is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for the silver target base case (power reflection, beam reflection, electron penetration depth, heat penetration depth, their ratio) from the paper's Tables 2 and 3 and conclusions.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Tables 2 and 3, and text stating h0/he ~ 0.7.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper: power reflection 16.1%, beam reflection 29.0%, electron depth 2.1 µm, heat depth 1.4 µm, ratio computed as 1.4/2.1 ≈ 0.6667.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the precise numbers the paper reports for the silver case; they serve as the authoritative reference a correct reproduction must match within tolerances.

outputs.description: Derived quantities from the Monte Carlo simulation of electron transport and energy deposition in silver for a 30 keV beam at normal incidence.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the agent's reported values to hidden reference values for the same material and beam conditions, applying appropriate tolerances for statistical reproducibility.
